title: Plant DNA Extraction and Preparation for ONT Sequencing
author: Boas Pucker
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bcvyiw7w
materials: Agarose gel: 1 µl DNA + 3 µl loading buffer + 3 µl water (1kb DNA ladder from NEB as size control; any large DNA fragment will do the job)

steps.title: Prepare CTAB1 Buffer
steps.instruction: Preheat 5 ml CTAB1 and 300 µL ß-ME in a 50 ml tube to 75 C.

steps.title: Homogenize Plant Material
steps.instruction: Homogenize less than 1g of fresh, young leaves (not previously frozen) using a mortar and pestle in liquid N2.

steps.title: Resuspend Material in Buffer
steps.instruction: Add the homogenized powder to the preheated CTAB1 buffer and resuspend carefully, avoiding the transfer of ice.

steps.title: Incubate Sample
steps.instruction: Incubate for at least 30 minutes (up to 2 hours), inverting tubes frequently to mix the solution.

steps.title: Perform First Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Separate the DNA from the organic phase using dichloromethane.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 ml dichloromethane and mix gently by inverting the tube.
Centrifuge for 30 minutes at >10,000 x g at room temperature.
Carefully transfer the colorless upper phase to a new 50 ml tube without disturbing the interphase.

steps.title: Perform Second Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Further purify the extract using CTAB2.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 ml CTAB2 and mix gently by inverting the tube.
Centrifuge for 30 minutes at >10,000 x g at room temperature.

steps.title: Precipitate and Wash DNA
steps.instruction: Recover the DNA pellet and wash to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 ml 1M NaCl and re-dissolve the pellet.
Add 2 ml Isopropanol and mix gently.
Centrifuge for 30 minutes at >10,000 x g at room temperature.
Wash the pellet with 2 ml 70% ethanol.
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at >10,000 x g at room temperature.

steps.title: Dissolve DNA Sediment
steps.instruction: Dissolve the sediment in 100 µl CTAB-TE via incubation overnight at room temperature (RNase is active during this time).

steps.title: Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Perform a NanoDrop measurement using 1 µl of the DNA solution (expected concentration: several µg/µl).

steps.title: Remove Short Fragments
steps.instruction: Remove short fragments following the SRE (Circulomics) handbook.

steps.title: Prepare ONT Library
steps.instruction: Prepare the library using LSK109, starting with 2 µg of DNA.

substeps.instruction: Increase the volume of the final Elution Buffer step to 25 µl.
Use half of the library (12 µl) for immediate sequencing.
Store the remaining library at 4 C in a fridge until needed.

steps.title: Perform Nuclease Flush
steps.instruction: If necessary (e.g., after 12-24 hours), perform a nuclease flush by incubating the flow cell with DNaseI for 2 hours.
